description: Active codebase — all runtime NixOS modules and flake entry point

core/.description: System-level NixOS modules (base OS + management tools)

management/.system-manager/: THE KEY MODULE — orchestrates system-update, backup, config-migration
management/.cli-registry/: CLI command registration system (ncc commands built here)
management/.cli-formatter/: Output formatting (colored messages, tables, badges, progress)
management/.module-manager/: Module loading, config merging with template defaults
management/.tui-engine/: Terminal UI framework for interactive commands

modules/.specialized/: chronicle (screen recording), AI workspace, SSH management

custom/.description: User's personal NixOS modules (preserved across updates, never overwritten)
